# gwz-sspi: bootstrap prerelease

This is an initial registration of the **gwz-sspi** crate, the contained Windows
SSPI authentication worker of the actively developed
[GWZ workspace manager](https://github.com/owebeeone/gwz-sspi).

**This prerelease contains no implementation or public API.** It is not a usable
release and should not be added as a dependency. The production code and its
release instructions are in the linked repository.

This publication establishes crate ownership so that releases are published only
by the repository's `release.yml` workflow, through crates.io Trusted Publishing.
Subsequent releases will contain the implementation.
